# This workflow will do a clean install of node dependencies, build the source code and run tests across different versions of node
# For more information see: https://help.github.com/actions/language-and-framework-guides/using-nodejs-with-github-actions

name: Node.js CI

env:
  GIT_REF: ${{ inputs.git_ref || github.ref }}

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    tags:
      - "**"
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]
  workflow_dispatch:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      git_ref:
        description: "Git ref to checkout (branch, tag, or commit SHA)"
        required: true
        type: string
      run_unit_tests:
        description: "Run unit tests job"
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: true
      run_integration_tests:
        description: "Run integration tests job"
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: true
      run_browser_tests:
        description: "Run browser tests job"
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: true
    secrets:
      GITLAB_REGISTRY_TOKEN:
        description: "GitLab deploy token with read_registry access"
        required: false

jobs:
  resolve_xrpld_image:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 2
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      image: ${{ steps.resolve.outputs.image }}
      is_private: ${{ steps.resolve.outputs.is_private }}

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.GIT_REF }}

      - name: Resolve xrpld image
        id: resolve
        env:
          IMAGE_CONFIG_FILE: .github/xrpld-image.env
          DEFAULT_IMAGE: rippleci/xrpld:develop
          PRIVATE_IMAGE_REPO: registry.gitlab.com/ripple/xrpledger/xrpld_package_deploy/xrpld-private
          GITLAB_REGISTRY_USERNAME: ${{ vars.GITLAB_REGISTRY_USERNAME }}
          GITLAB_REGISTRY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITLAB_REGISTRY_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          # Read the requested private version from the committed config file.
          # The file is never sourced: on fork pull requests its contents are
          # untrusted, so we only extract the value and validate it strictly.
          PRIVATE_VERSION=""
          if [[ -f "${IMAGE_CONFIG_FILE}" ]]; then
            RAW_LINE="$(grep -E '^[[:space:]]*XRPLD_PRIVATE_VERSION[[:space:]]*=' "${IMAGE_CONFIG_FILE}" | tail -n1 || true)"
            PRIVATE_VERSION="$(printf '%s' "${RAW_LINE#*=}" | tr -d "[:space:]\"'")"
          fi

          if [[ -z "${PRIVATE_VERSION}" ]]; then
            echo "No private xrpld version configured in ${IMAGE_CONFIG_FILE}; using default image ${DEFAULT_IMAGE}."
            {
              echo "image=${DEFAULT_IMAGE}"
              echo "is_private=false"
            } >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
            exit 0
          fi

          if ! [[ "${PRIVATE_VERSION}" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(-(b|rc)[0-9]+)?$ ]]; then
            echo "XRPLD_PRIVATE_VERSION in ${IMAGE_CONFIG_FILE} must use X.Y.Z, X.Y.Z-bN, or X.Y.Z-rcN format (got '${PRIVATE_VERSION}')." >&2
            exit 1
          fi

          if [[ -z "${GITLAB_REGISTRY_USERNAME}" || -z "${GITLAB_REGISTRY_TOKEN}" ]]; then
            echo "A private xrpld version (${PRIVATE_VERSION}) is configured but the GITLAB_REGISTRY_USERNAME variable and GITLAB_REGISTRY_TOKEN secret are unavailable. These are not exposed to fork pull requests; run the private build from a branch in this repository, or clear XRPLD_PRI

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
